"87288a10-0160-532d-b809-b0f7a4ddc5a5" :question/problem "Evaluate exactly.

$$
\int_{0}^{\frac{1}{8}} \frac{4}{\sqrt{1 - 16 x^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

Choose the exact value."] [:db/add "87288a10-0160-532d-b809-b0f7a4ddc5a5" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=4 x$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(4)\,\mathrm{d}x$.

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{4}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $4\cdot \frac{1}{4}=1$.

Transform both bounds:

$$
\begin{aligned}x=0&\Longrightarrow u=0\\x=\frac{1}{8}&\Longrightarrow u=\frac{1}{2}\end{aligned}
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int_{0}^{\frac{1}{8}} \frac{4}{\sqrt{1 - 16 x^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\int_{0}^{\frac{1}{2}} \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u.\end{aligned}
$$

Endpoint values: $\arcsin{\left(0 \right)}=0,\quad \arcsin{\left(\frac{1}{2} \right)}=\frac{\pi}{6}$.

Use the integration rule:

$$
\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u=\arcsin{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

Evaluate the primitive and subtract lower from upper:

$$
\left[\arcsin{\left(u \right)}\right]_{0}^{\frac{1}{2}}=\left(\frac{\pi}{6}\right)-\left(0\right).
$$

The exact answer is

$$
\frac{\pi}{6}.
$$"] [:db/add "87288a10-0160-532d-b809-b0f7a4ddc5a5" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy] [:db/add "87288a10-0160-532d-b809-b0f7a4ddc5a5" :question/answer-fields "aa1c5f06-a5af-50b4-9e18-5cc43e3dce49"] [:db/add "aa1c5f06-a5af-50b4-9e18-5cc43e3dce49" :question/problem "Evaluate exactly.

$$
\int_{0}^{\frac{1}{2}} \frac{1}{4 x^{2} + 1}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

Choose the exact value."] [:db/add "aa1c5f06-a5af-50b4-9e18-5cc43e3dce49" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=2 x$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(2)\,\mathrm{d}x$.

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{2}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $1\cdot \frac{1}{2}=\frac{1}{2}$.

Transform both bounds:

$$
\begin{aligned}x=0&\Longrightarrow u=0\\x=\frac{1}{2}&\Longrightarrow u=1\end{aligned}
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int_{0}^{\frac{1}{2}} \frac{1}{4 x^{2} + 1}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{1}{2}\left(\int_{0}^{1} \frac{1}{u^{2} + 1}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Endpoint values: $\arctan{\left(0 \right)}=0,\quad \arctan{\left(1 \right)}=\frac{\pi}{4}$.

Use the integration rule:

$$
\int \frac{1}{u^{2} + 1}\,\mathrm{d}u=\arctan{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

Evaluate the primitive and subtract lower from upper:

$$
\frac{1}{2}\left(\left[\arctan{\left(u \right)}\right]_{0}^{1}\right)=\frac{1}{2}\left(\left(\frac{\pi}{4}\right)-\left(0\right)\right).
$$

The exact answer is

$$
\frac{\pi}{8}.
$$"] [:db/add "aa1c5f06-a5af-50b4-9e18-5cc43e3dce49" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy] [:db/add "aa1c5f06-a5af-50b4-9e18-5cc43e3dce49" :question/answer-fields "faeff81c-1bda-54ce-8635-ef5efe9f62ef"] [:db/add "faeff81c-1bda-54ce-8635-ef5efe9f62ef" :question/problem "Evaluate exactly.

\int_{- \frac{1}{4}}^{0} \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - 4 x^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}x

Choose the exact value."] [:db/add "faeff81c-1bda-54ce-8635-ef5efe9f62ef" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=2 x$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(2)\,\mathrm{d}x$.

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{2}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $1\cdot \frac{1}{2}=\frac{1}{2}$.

Transform both bounds:

$$
\begin{aligned}x=- \frac{1}{4}&\Longrightarrow u=- \frac{1}{2}\\x=0&\Longrightarrow u=0\end{aligned}
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int_{- \frac{1}{4}}^{0} \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - 4 x^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{1}{2}\left(\int_{- \frac{1}{2}}^{0} \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Endpoint values: $\arcsin{\left(- \frac{1}{2} \right)}=- \frac{\pi}{6},\quad \arcsin{\left(0 \right)}=0$.

Use the integration rule:

$$
\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u=\arcsin{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

Evaluate the primitive and subtract lower from upper:

$$
\frac{1}{2}\left(\left[\arcsin{\left(u \right)}\right]_{- \frac{1}{2}}^{0}\right)=\frac{1}{2}\left(\left(0\right)-\left(- \frac{\pi}{6}\right)\right).
$$

The exact answer is

$$
\frac{\pi}{12}.
$$"] [:db/add "faeff81c-1bda-54ce-8635-ef5efe9f62ef" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy] [:db/add "faeff81c-1bda-54ce-8635-ef5efe9f62ef" :question/answer-fields "7e848776-98b6-587b-8d7e-6e39a34f98ec" :question/id #uuid "7e848776-98b6-587b-8d7e-6e39a34f98ec"] [:db/add "7e848776-98b6-587b-8d7e-6e39a34f98ec" :question/problem "Evaluate exactly.

$$
\int_{- \frac{1}{5}}^{0} \frac{3}{25 x^{2} + 1}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

Choose the exact value."] [:db/add "7e848776-98b6-587b-8d7e-6e39a34f98ec" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=5 x$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(5)\,\mathrm{d}x$.

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{5}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $3\cdot \frac{1}{5}=\frac{3}{5}$.

Transform both bounds:

$$
\begin{aligned}x=- \frac{1}{5}&\Longrightarrow u=-1\\x=0&\Longrightarrow u=0\end{aligned}
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int_{- \frac{1}{5}}^{0} \frac{3}{25 x^{2} + 1}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{3}{5}\left(\int_{-1}^{0} \frac{1}{u^{2} + 1}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Endpoint values: $\arctan{\left(-1 \right)}=- \frac{\pi}{4},\quad \arctan{\left(0 \right)}=0$.

Use the integration rule:

$$
\int \frac{1}{u^{2} + 1}\,\mathrm{d}u=\arctan{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

Evaluate the primitive and subtract lower from upper:

$$
\frac{3}{5}\left(\left[\arctan{\left(u \right)}\right]_{-1}^{0}\right)=\frac{3}{5}\left(\left(0\right)-\left(- \frac{\pi}{4}\right)\right).
$$

The exact answer is

$$
\frac{3 \pi}{20}.
$$"] [:db/add "7e848776-98b6-587b-8d7e-6e39a34f98ec" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy] [:db/add "7e848776-98b6-587b-8d7e-6e39a34f98ec" :question/answer-fields "837b2f87-f619-55e2-a896-14f85a03de55"] [:db/add "837b2f87-f619-55e2-a896-14f85a03de55" :question/problem "Evaluate exactly.

$$
\int_{0}^{\frac{1}{4}} \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - 4 x^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

Choose the exact value."] [:db/add "837b2f87-f619-55e2-a896-14f85a03de55" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=2 x$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(2)\,\mathrm{d}x$.

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{2}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $1\cdot \frac{1}{2}=\frac{1}{2}$.

Transform both bounds:

$$
\begin{aligned}x=0&\Longrightarrow u=0\\x=\frac{1}{4}&\Longrightarrow u=\frac{1}{2}\end{aligned}
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int_{0}^{\frac{1}{4}} \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - 4 x^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{1}{2}\left(\int_{0}^{\frac{1}{2}} \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Endpoint values: $\arcsin{\left(0 \right)}=0,\quad \arcsin{\left(\frac{1}{2} \right)}=\frac{\pi}{6}$.

Use the integration rule:

$$
\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u=\arcsin{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

Evaluate the primitive and subtract lower from upper:

$$
\frac{1}{2}\left(\left[\arcsin{\left(u \right)}\right]_{0}^{\frac{1}{2}}\right)=\frac{1}{2}\left(\left(\frac{\pi}{6}\right)-\left(0\right)\right).
$$

The exact answer is

$$
\frac{\pi}{12}.
$$"] [:db/add "837b2f87-f619-55e2-a896-14f85a03de55" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy] [:db/add "837b2f87-f619-55e2-a896-14f85a03de55" :question/answer-fields Choose the exact value."] [:db/add "02ac7814-feae-502f-a5b0-0a640bad7add" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=3 x$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(3)\,\mathrm{d}x$.

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{3}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $3\cdot \frac{1}{3}=1$.

Transform both bounds:

$$
\begin{aligned}x=0&\Longrightarrow u=0\\x=\frac{1}{3}&\Longrightarrow u=1\end{aligned}
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int_{0}^{\frac{1}{3}} \frac{3}{9 x^{2} + 1}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\int_{0}^{1} \frac{1}{u^{2} + 1}\,\mathrm{d}u.\end{aligned}
$$

Endpoint values: $\arctan{\left(0 \right)}=0,\quad \arctan{\left(1 \right)}=\frac{\pi}{4}$.

Use the integration rule:

$$
\int \frac{1}{u^{2} + 1}\,\mathrm{d}u=\arctan{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

Evaluate the primitive and subtract lower from upper:

$$
\left[\arctan{\left(u \right)}\right]_{0}^{1}=\left(\frac{\pi}{4}\right)-\left(0\right).
$$

The exact answer is

$$
\frac{\pi}{4}.
$$"] [:db/add "02ac7814-feae-502f-a5b0-0a640bad7add" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy] [:db/add "02ac7814-feae-502f-a5b0-0a640bad7add" :question/answer-fields "10a86c5d-b9dc-5297-ab21-4f6e03f59eca" :question/id #uuid "10a86c5d-b9dc-5297-ab21-4f6e03f59eca"] [:db/add "10a86c5d-b9dc-5297-ab21-4f6e03f59eca" :question/problem "Evaluate exactly.

$$
\int_{- \frac{1}{5}}^{0} \frac{2}{25 x^{2} + 1}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

Choose the exact value."] [:db/add "10a86c5d-b9dc-5297-ab21-4f6e03f59eca" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=5 x$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(5)\,\mathrm{d}x$.

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{5}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $2\cdot \frac{1}{5}=\frac{2}{5}$.

Transform both bounds:

$$
\begin{aligned}x=- \frac{1}{5}&\Longrightarrow u=-1\\x=0&\Longrightarrow u=0\end{aligned}
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int_{- \frac{1}{5}}^{0} \frac{2}{25 x^{2} + 1}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{2}{5}\left(\int_{-1}^{0} \frac{1}{u^{2} + 1}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Endpoint values: $\arctan{\left(-1 \right)}=- \frac{\pi}{4},\quad \arctan{\left(0 \right)}=0$.

Use the integration rule:

$$
\int \frac{1}{u^{2} + 1}\,\mathrm{d}u=\arctan{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

Evaluate the primitive and subtract lower from upper:

$$
\frac{2}{5}\left(\left[\arctan{\left(u \right)}\right]_{-1}^{0}\right)=\frac{2}{5}\left(\left(0\right)-\left(- \frac{\pi}{4}\right)\right).
$$

The exact answer is

$$
\frac{\pi}{10}.
$$"] [:db/add "10a86c5d-b9dc-5297-ab21-4f6e03f59eca" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy] [:db/add "10a86c5d-b9dc-5297-ab21-4f6e03f59eca" :question/answer-fields "c5cb26e3-8759-56b5-bb30-313381ee7280"] [:db/ensure "10a86c5d-b9dc-5297-ab21-4f6e03f59eca" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186064220 :knowledge-point/questions "10a86c5d-b9dc-5297-ab21-4f6e03f59eca"] [:db/add "ce6bc08f-8eed-50f7-8ce0-d6396cded99c" :answer/id #uuid "ce6bc08f-8eed-50f7-8ce0-d6396cded99c"] [:db/add "ce6bc08f-8eed-50f7-8ce0-d6396cded99c" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "ce6bc08f-8eed-50f7-8ce0-d6396cded99c" :answer/value "\frac{\pi}{10}"] [:db/ensure "ce6bc08f-8eed-50f7-8ce0-d6396cded99c" :answer/validate] [:db/add "5e4c11c1-503a-5f4e-9d8b-b90474f087ce" :answer-field/id #uuid "5e4c11c1-503a-5f4e-9d8b-b90474f087ce"] [:db/add "5e4c11c1-503a-5f4e-9d8b-b90474f087ce" :answer-field/key "answer"] [:db/add "5e4c11c1-503a-5f4e-9d8b-b90474f087ce" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "5e4c11c1-503a-5f4e-9d8b-b90474f087ce" :answer-field/choices "ce6bc08f-8eed-50f7-8ce0-d6396cded99c"] [:db/add "5e4c11c1-503a-5f4e-9d8b-b90474f087ce" :answer-field/correct "ce6bc08f-8eed-50f7-8ce0-d6396cded99c"] [:db/ensure "5e4c11c1-503a-5f4e-9d8b-b90474f087ce" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "e99bd3d1-b2c7-55da-9169-4f058c9afd0b" :question/id #uuid "e99bd3d1-b2c7-55da-9169-4f058c9afd0b"] [:db/add "e99bd3d1-b2c7-55da-9169-4f058c9afd0b" :question/problem "Evaluate exactly.

$$
\int_{0}^{5} \frac{2}{x^{2} + 25}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

{{answer}}"] [:db/add "e99bd3d1-b2c7-55da-9169-4f058c9afd0b" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=\frac{x}{5}$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(\frac{1}{5})\,\mathrm{d}x$.

Normalize the denominator:

$$
x^{2} + 25=25\left(1+(\frac{x}{5})^2\right).
$$

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=5\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $\frac{2}{25}\cdot 5=\frac{2}{5}$.

Transform both bounds:

$$
\begin{aligned}x=0&\Longrightarrow u=0\\x=5&\Longrightarrow u=1\end{aligned}
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int_{0}^{5} \frac{2}{x^{2} + 25}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{2}{5}\left(\int_{0}^{1} \frac{1}{u^{2} + 1}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Endpoint values: $\arctan{\left(0 \right)}=0,\quad \arctan{\left(1 \right)}=\frac{\pi}{4}$.

Use the integration rule:

$$
\int \frac{1}{u^{2} + 1}\,\mathrm{d}u=\arctan{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

Evaluate the primitive and subtract lower from upper:

$$
\frac{2}{5}\left(\left[\arctan{\left(u \right)}\right]_{0}^{1}\right)=\frac{2}{5}\left(\left(\frac{\pi}{4}\right)-\left(0\right)\right).
$$

The exact answer is

$$
\frac{\pi}{10}.
$$"] [:db/add "e99bd3d1-b2c7-55da-9169-4f058c9afd0b" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate] [:db/add "e99bd3d1-b2c7-55da-9169-4f058c9afd0b" :question/answer-fields "5e4c11c1-503a-5f4e-9d8b-b90474f087ce"] [:db/ensure "e99bd3d1-b2c7-55da-9169-4f058c9afd0b" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186064220 :knowledge-point/questions "e99bd3d1-b2c7-55da-9169-4f058c9afd0b"] [:db/add "b4efd285-7561-56f4-bccc-435c7e27f225" :answer/id #uuid "b4efd285-7561-56f4-bccc-435c7e27f225"] [:db/add "b4efd285-7561-56f4-bccc-435c7e27f225" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "b4efd285-7561-56f4-bccc-435c7e27f225" :answer/value "\frac{\pi}{3}"] [:db/ensure "b4efd285-7561-56f4-bccc-435c7e27f225" :answer/validate] [:db/add "c2c51ac5-8776-5b03-b151-314d5edb2a90" :answer-field/id #uuid "c2c51ac5-8776-5b03-b151-314d5edb2a90"] [:db/add "c2c51ac5-8776-5b03-b151-314d5edb2a90" :answer-field/key "answer"] [:db/add "c2c51ac5-8776-5b03-b151-314d5edb2a90" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "c2c51ac5-8776-5b03-b151-314d5edb2a90" :answer-field/choices "b4efd285-7561-56f4-bccc-435c7e27f225"] [:db/add "c2c51ac5-8776-5b03-b151-314d5edb2a90" :answer-field/correct "b4efd285-7561-56f4-bccc-435c7e27f225"] [:db/ensure "c2c51ac5-8776-5b03-b151-314d5edb2a90" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "46f7c08c-b23a-52df-8bc9-26e935781bdc" :question/id #uuid "46f7c08c-b23a-52df-8bc9-26e935781bdc"] [:db/add "46f7c08c-b23a-52df-8bc9-26e935781bdc" :question/problem "Evaluate exactly.

$$
\int_{0}^{2} \frac{2}{\sqrt{16 - x^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

{{answer}}"] [:db/add "46f7c08c-b23a-52df-8bc9-26e935781bdc" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=\frac{x}{4}$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(\frac{1}{4})\,\mathrm{d}x$.

Normalize the denominator:

$$
\sqrt{16 - x^{2}}=4\sqrt{1-(\frac{x}{4})^2}.
$$

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=4\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $\frac{1}{2}\cdot 4=2$.

Transform both bounds:

$$
\begin{aligned}x=0&\Longrightarrow u=0\\x=2&\Longrightarrow u=\frac{1}{2}\end{aligned}
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int_{0}^{2} \frac{2}{\sqrt{16 - x^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=2\left(\int_{0}^{\frac{1}{2}} \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Endpoint values: $\arcsin{\left(0 \right)}=0,\quad \arcsin{\left(\frac{1}{2} \right)}=\frac{\pi}{6}$.

Use the integration rule:

$$
\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u=\arcsin{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

Evaluate the primitive and subtract lower from upper:

$$
2\left(\left[\arcsin{\left(u \right)}\right]_{0}^{\frac{1}{2}}\right)=2\left(\left(\frac{\pi}{6}\right)-\left(0\right)\right).
$$

The exact answer is

$$
\frac{\pi}{3}.
$$"] [:db/add "46f7c08c-b23a-52df-8bc9-26e935781bdc" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate] [:db/add "46f7c08c-b23a-52df-8bc9-26e935781bdc" :question/answer-fields "c2c51ac5-8776-5b03-b151-314d5edb2a90"] [:db/ensure "46f7c08c-b23a-52df-8bc9-26e935781bdc" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186064220 :knowledge-point/questions "46f7c08c-b23a-52df-8bc9-26e935781bdc"] [:db/add "cd2d16ed-0a22-517d-aff0-2fc17e5cbd6c" :answer/id #uuid "cd2d16ed-0a22-517d-aff0-2fc17e5cbd6c"] [:db/add "cd2d16ed-0a22-517d-aff0-2fc17e5cbd6c" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "cd2d16ed-0a22-517d-aff0-2fc17e5cbd6c" :answer/value "\frac{\pi}{15}"] [:db/ensure "cd2d16ed-0a22-517d-aff0-2fc17e5cbd6c" :answer/validate] [:db/add "1749ef1b-b7dd-5332-b751-7e02c047f761" :answer-field/id #uuid "1749ef1b-b7dd-5332-b751-7e02c047f761"] [:db/add "1749ef1b-b7dd-5332-b751-7e02c047f761" :answer-field/key "answer"] [:db/add "1749ef1b-b7dd-5332-b751-7e02c047f761" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "1749ef1b-b7dd-5332-b751-7e02c047f761" :answer-field/choices "cd2d16ed-0a22-517d-aff0-2fc17e5cbd6c"] [:db/add "1749ef1b-b7dd-5332-b751-7e02c047f761" :answer-field/correct "cd2d16ed-0a22-517d-aff0-2fc17e5cbd6c"] [:db/ensure "1749ef1b-b7dd-5332-b751-7e02c047f761" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "29922848-0161-5ee9-b650-fe402a88aa8f" :question/id #uuid "29922848-0161-5ee9-b650-fe402a88aa8f"] [:db/add "29922848-0161-5ee9-b650-fe402a88aa8f" :question/problem "Evaluate exactly.

{{answer}}"] [:db/add "9fa48c8e-d2b6-5eba-8ad3-f816664db3eb" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=\frac{x}{5}$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(\frac{1}{5})\,\mathrm{d}x$.

$$
\begin{aligned}x=0&\Longrightarrow u=0\\x=\frac{5 \sqrt{2}}{2}&\Longrightarrow u=\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\end{aligned}
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int_{0}^{\frac{5 \sqrt{2}}{2}} \frac{4}{\sqrt{25 - x^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=4\left(\int_{0}^{\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}} \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Endpoint values: $\arcsin{\left(0 \right)}=0,\quad \arcsin{\left(\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2} \right)}=\frac{\pi}{4}$.

Use the integration rule:

$$
\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u=\arcsin{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

Evaluate the primitive and subtract lower from upper:

$$
4\left(\left[\arcsin{\left(u \right)}\right]_{0}^{\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}}\right)=4\left(\left(\frac{\pi}{4}\right)-\left(0\right)\right).
$$

The exact answer is

$$
\int_{-4}^{4} \frac{2}{x^{2} + 16}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

{{answer}}"] [:db/add "b5286232-dcfd-5ef5-b3e2-5f7420d2ca2f" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=\frac{x}{4}$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(\frac{1}{4})\,\mathrm{d}x$.

Normalize the denominator:

$$
x^{2} + 16=16\left(1+(\frac{x}{4})^2\right).
$$

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=4\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $\frac{1}{8}\cdot 4=\frac{1}{2}$.

Transform both bounds:

$$
\begin{aligned}x=-4&\Longrightarrow u=-1\\x=4&\Longrightarrow u=1\end{aligned}
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int_{-4}^{4} \frac{2}{x^{2} + 16}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{1}{2}\left(\int_{-1}^{1} \frac{1}{u^{2} + 1}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Endpoint values: $\arctan{\left(-1 \right)}=- \frac{\pi}{4},\quad \arctan{\left(1 \right)}=\frac{\pi}{4}$.

Use the integration rule:

$$
\int \frac{1}{u^{2} + 1}\,\mathrm{d}u=\arctan{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

Evaluate the primitive and subtract lower from upper:

$$
\frac{1}{2}\left(\left[\arctan{\left(u \right)}\right]_{-1}^{1}\right)=\frac{1}{2}\left(\left(\frac{\pi}{4}\right)-\left(- \frac{\pi}{4}\right)\right).
$$

The exact answer is

$$
\frac{\pi}{4}.
$$"] [:db/add "b5286232-dcfd-5ef5-b3e2-5f7420d2ca2f" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate] [:db/add "b5286232-dcfd-5ef5-b3e2-5f7420d2ca2f" :question/answer-fields "e4e0a536-3443-5d5d-926c-ef349b9c9b62"] [:db/ensure "b5286232-dcfd-5ef5-b3e2-5f7420d2ca2f" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186064220 :knowledge-point/questions "b5286232-dcfd-5ef5-b3e2-5f7420d2ca2f"] [:db/add "b6d82fcd-f8e6-5c42-9362-e0c21d7f479f" :answer/id #uuid "b6d82fcd-f8e6-5c42-9362-e0c21d7f479f"] [:db/add "b6d82fcd-f8e6-5c42-9362-e0c21d7f479f" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "b6d82fcd-f8e6-5c42-9362-e0c21d7f479f" :answer/value "\frac{\pi}{3}"] [:db/ensure "b6d82fcd-f8e6-5c42-9362-e0c21d7f479f" :answer/validate] [:db/add "5071aab3-0b63-575b-8580-6b3743d0842b" :answer-field/id #uuid "5071aab3-0b63-575b-8580-6b3743d0842b"] [:db/add "5071aab3-0b63-575b-8580-6b3743d0842b" :answer-field/key "answer"] [:db/add "5071aab3-0b63-575b-8580-6b3743d0842b" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "5071aab3-0b63-575b-8580-6b3743d0842b" :answer-field/choices "b6d82fcd-f8e6-5c42-9362-e0c21d7f479f"] [:db/add "5071aab3-0b63-575b-8580-6b3743d0842b" :answer-field/correct "b6d82fcd-f8e6-5c42-9362-e0c21d7f479f"] [:db/ensure "5071aab3-0b63-575b-8580-6b3743d0842b" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "0ee19251-9ec3-50f8-afac-37a3b36232b0" :question/id #uuid "0ee19251-9ec3-50f8-afac-37a3b36232b0"] [:db/add "0ee19251-9ec3-50f8-afac-37a3b36232b0" :question/problem "Evaluate exactly.

{{answer}}"] [:db/add "0ee19251-9ec3-50f8-afac-37a3b36232b0" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=\frac{x}{3}$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(\frac{1}{3})\,\mathrm{d}x$.

Normalize the denominator:

$$
\sqrt{9 - x^{2}}=3\sqrt{1-(\frac{x}{3})^2}.
$$

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=3\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $\frac{1}{3}\cdot 3=1$.

Transform both bounds:

$$
\begin{aligned}x=- \frac{3}{2}&\Longrightarrow u=- \frac{1}{2}\\x=\frac{3}{2}&\Longrightarrow u=\frac{1}{2}\end{aligned}
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int_{- \frac{3}{2}}^{\frac{3}{2}} \frac{1}{\sqrt{9 - x^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\int_{- \frac{1}{2}}^{\frac{1}{2}} \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u.\end{aligned}
$$

Endpoint values: $\arcsin{\left(- \frac{1}{2} \right)}=- \frac{\pi}{6},\quad \arcsin{\left(\frac{1}{2} \right)}=\frac{\pi}{6}$.

Use the integration rule:

$$
\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u=\arcsin{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

Evaluate the primitive and subtract lower from upper:

$$
\left[\arcsin{\left(u \right)}\right]_{- \frac{1}{2}}^{\frac{1}{2}}=\left(\frac{\pi}{6}\right)-\left(- \frac{\pi}{6}\right).
$$

The exact answer is

$$
\frac{\pi}{3}.
$$"] [:db/add "0ee19251-9ec3-50f8-afac-37a3b36232b0" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate] [:db/add "0ee19251-9ec3-50f8-afac-37a3b36232b0" :question/answer-fields "5071aab3-0b63-575b-8580-6b3743d0842b"] [:db/ensure "0ee19251-9ec3-50f8-afac-37a3b36232b0" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186064220 :knowledge-point/questions "0ee19251-9ec3-50f8-afac-37a3b36232b0"] [:db/add "57a22543-28d5-5089-8691-a57799840d66" :answer/id #uuid "57a22543-28d5-5089-8691-a57799840d66"] [:db/add "57a22543-28d5-5089-8691-a57799840d66" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "57a22543-28d5-5089-8691-a57799840d66" :answer/value "\frac{\pi}{18}"] [:db/ensure "57a22543-28d5-5089-8691-a57799840d66" :answer/validate] [:db/add "1f2fd66c-c278-5547-a2e0-a6c78f6e834b" :answer-field/id #uuid "1f2fd66c-c278-5547-a2e0-a6c78f6e834b"] [:db/add "1f2fd66c-c278-5547-a2e0-a6c78f6e834b" :answer-field/key "answer"] [:db/add "1f2fd66c-c278-5547-a2e0-a6c78f6e834b" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "1f2fd66c-c278-5547-a2e0-a6c78f6e834b" :answer-field/choices "57a22543-28d5-5089-8691-a57799840d66"] [:db/add "1f2fd66c-c278-5547-a2e0-a6c78f6e834b" :answer-field/correct "57a22543-28d5-5089-8691-a57799840d66"] [:db/ensure "1f2fd66c-c278-5547-a2e0-a6c78f6e834b" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "ba24a3c5-0af8-5f12-bad0-104365814844" :question/id #uuid "ba24a3c5-0af8-5f12-bad0-104365814844"] [:db/add "ba24a3c5-0af8-5f12-bad0-104365814844" :question/problem "Evaluate exactly.

{{answer}}"] [:db/add "ba24a3c5-0af8-5f12-bad0-104365814844" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=\frac{x}{3}$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(\frac{1}{3})\,\mathrm{d}x$.

$$
\frac{2}{3}\left(\left[\arctan{\left(u \right)}\right]_{\frac{\sqrt{3}}{3}}^{1}\right)=\frac{2}{3}\left(\left(\frac{\pi}{4}\right)-\left(\frac{\pi}{6}\right)\right).
$$

The exact answer is

$$
\frac{\pi}{18}.
$$"] [:db/add "ba24a3c5-0af8-5f12-bad0-104365814844" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate] [:db/add "ba24a3c5-0af8-5f12-bad0-104365814844" :question/answer-fields "1f2fd66c-c278-5547-a2e0-a6c78f6e834b"] [:db/ensure "ba24a3c5-0af8-5f12-bad0-104365814844" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186064220 :knowledge-point/questions "ba24a3c5-0af8-5f12-bad0-104365814844"] [:db/add "fe9023ae-c864-5d76-9a15-13dce5a7ca60" :answer/id #uuid "fe9023ae-c864-5d76-9a15-13dce5a7ca60"] [:db/add "fe9023ae-c864-5d76-9a15-13dce5a7ca60" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "fe9023ae-c864-5d76-9a15-13dce5a7ca60" :answer/value "\frac{\pi}{4}"] [:db/ensure "fe9023ae-c864-5d76-9a15-13dce5a7ca60" :answer/validate] [:db/add "d6296145-a5c1-5ba5-8007-818515d6ea25" :answer-field/id #uuid "d6296145-a5c1-5ba5-8007-818515d6ea25"] [:db/add "d6296145-a5c1-5ba5-8007-818515d6ea25" :answer-field/key "answer"] [:db/add "d6296145-a5c1-5ba5-8007-818515d6ea25" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "d6296145-a5c1-5ba5-8007-818515d6ea25" :answer-field/choices "fe9023ae-c864-5d76-9a15-13dce5a7ca60"] [:db/add "d6296145-a5c1-5ba5-8007-818515d6ea25" :answer-field/correct "fe9023ae-c864-5d76-9a15-13dce5a7ca60"] [:db/ensure "d6296145-a5c1-5ba5-8007-818515d6ea25" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "6ac272a5-80c3-5610-9fdd-20599dd9ef28" :question/id #uuid "6ac272a5-80c3-5610-9fdd-20599dd9ef28"] [:db/add "6ac272a5-80c3-5610-9fdd-20599dd9ef28" :question/problem "Evaluate exactly.

{{answer}}"] [:db/add "6ac272a5-80c3-5610-9fdd-20599dd9ef28" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=\frac{x}{2}$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(\frac{1}{2})\,\mathrm{d}x$.

{{answer}}"] [:db/add "d5f42ff5-5444-50e8-91bf-056a3b48e465" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=\frac{\sqrt{3} x}{3}$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{3})\,\mathrm{d}x$.

Normalize the denominator:

$$
x^{2} + 3=3\left(1+(\frac{\sqrt{3} x}{3})^2\right).
$$

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=\sqrt{3}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $\frac{1}{3}\cdot \sqrt{3}=\frac{\sqrt{3}}{3}$.

Transform both bounds:

$$
\begin{aligned}x=0&\Longrightarrow u=0\\x=1&\Longrightarrow u=\frac{\sqrt{3}}{3}\end{aligned}
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int_{0}^{1} \frac{1}{x^{2} + 3}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{\sqrt{3}}{3}\left(\int_{0}^{\frac{\sqrt{3}}{3}} \frac{1}{u^{2} + 1}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Endpoint values: $\arctan{\left(0 \right)}=0,\quad \arctan{\left(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{3} \right)}=\frac{\pi}{6}$.

Use the integration rule:

$$
\int \frac{1}{u^{2} + 1}\,\mathrm{d}u=\arctan{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

Evaluate the primitive and subtract lower from upper:

$$
\frac{\sqrt{3}}{3}\left(\left[\arctan{\left(u \right)}\right]_{0}^{\frac{\sqrt{3}}{3}}\right)=\frac{\sqrt{3}}{3}\left(\left(\frac{\pi}{6}\right)-\left(0\right)\right).
$$

The exact answer is

{{answer}}"] [:db/add "fc989089-ee91-5602-b354-1363e3229631" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=\frac{\sqrt{2} x}{2}$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2})\,\mathrm{d}x$.

Normalize the denominator:

$$
\sqrt{2 - x^{2}}=\sqrt{2}\sqrt{1-(\frac{\sqrt{2} x}{2})^2}.
$$

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=\sqrt{2}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $\sqrt{2}\cdot \sqrt{2}=2$.

Transform both bounds:

$$
\begin{aligned}x=-1&\Longrightarrow u=- \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\\x=0&\Longrightarrow u=0\end{aligned}
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int_{-1}^{0} \frac{2}{\sqrt{2 - x^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=2\left(\int_{- \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}}^{0} \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Endpoint values: $\arcsin{\left(- \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2} \right)}=- \frac{\pi}{4},\quad \arcsin{\left(0 \right)}=0$.

Use the integration rule:

$$
\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u=\arcsin{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

Evaluate the primitive and subtract lower from upper:

$$
2\left(\left[\arcsin{\left(u \right)}\right]_{- \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}}^{0}\right)=2\left(\left(0\right)-\left(- \frac{\pi}{4}\right)\right).
$$

The exact answer is

$$
\frac{\pi}{2}.
$$"] [:db/add "fc989089-ee91-5602-b354-1363e3229631" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/hard] [:db/add "fc989089-ee91-5602-b354-1363e3229631" :question/answer-fields "f244f8d2-4622-55b9-8ad2-276b6fcf3652"] [:db/ensure "fc989089-ee91-5602-b354-1363e3229631" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186064220 :knowledge-point/questions "fc989089-ee91-5602-b354-1363e3229631"] [:db/add "af8c3b5d-659b-5ca4-8e21-2fc11a7d934b" :answer/id #uuid "af8c3b5d-659b-5ca4-8e21-2fc11a7d934b"] [:db/add "af8c3b5d-659b-5ca4-8e21-2fc11a7d934b" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "af8c3b5d-659b-5ca4-8e21-2fc11a7d934b" :answer/value "\frac{\sqrt{3} \pi}{18}"] [:db/ensure "af8c3b5d-659b-5ca4-8e21-2fc11a7d934b" :answer/validate] [:db/add "e1fb631e-8d15-57f6-8580-ccaede1aab9a" :answer-field/id #uuid "e1fb631e-8d15-57f6-8580-ccaede1aab9a"] [:db/add "e1fb631e-8d15-57f6-8580-ccaede1aab9a" :answer-field/key "answer"] [:db/add "e1fb631e-8d15-57f6-8580-ccaede1aab9a" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "e1fb631e-8d15-57f6-8580-ccaede1aab9a" :answer-field/choices "af8c3b5d-659b-5ca4-8e21-2fc11a7d934b"] [:db/add "e1fb631e-8d15-57f6-8580-ccaede1aab9a" :answer-field/correct "af8c3b5d-659b-5ca4-8e21-2fc11a7d934b"] [:db/ensure "e1fb631e-8d15-57f6-8580-ccaede1aab9a" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "58813c00-a5b8-5081-ba5b-d06a58cf7795" :question/id #uuid "58813c00-a5b8-5081-ba5b-d06a58cf7795"] [:db/add "58813c00-a5b8-5081-ba5b-d06a58cf7795" :question/problem "Evaluate exactly.

{{answer}}"] [:db/add "58813c00-a5b8-5081-ba5b-d06a58cf7795" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=\frac{\sqrt{3} x}{6}$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{6})\,\mathrm{d}x$.

Normalize the denominator:

$$
x^{2} + 12=12\left(1+(\frac{\sqrt{3} x}{6})^2\right).
$$

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=2 \sqrt{3}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $\frac{1}{12}\cdot 2 \sqrt{3}=\frac{\sqrt{3}}{6}$.

Transform both bounds:

$$
\begin{aligned}x=-6&\Longrightarrow u=- \sqrt{3}\\x=0&\Longrightarrow u=0\end{aligned}
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int_{-6}^{0} \frac{1}{x^{2} + 12}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{\sqrt{3}}{6}\left(\int_{- \sqrt{3}}^{0} \frac{1}{u^{2} + 1}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Endpoint values: $\arctan{\left(- \sqrt{3} \right)}=- \frac{\pi}{3},\quad \arctan{\left(0 \right)}=0$.

Use the integration rule:

$$
\int \frac{1}{u^{2} + 1}\,\mathrm{d}u=\arctan{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

Evaluate the primitive and subtract lower from upper:

$$
\frac{\sqrt{3}}{6}\left(\left[\arctan{\left(u \right)}\right]_{- \sqrt{3}}^{0}\right)=\frac{\sqrt{3}}{6}\left(\left(0\right)-\left(- \frac{\pi}{3}\right)\right).
$$

The exact answer is

$$
\frac{\sqrt{3} \pi}{18}.
$$"] [:db/add "58813c00-a5b8-5081-ba5b-d06a58cf7795" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/hard] [:db/add "58813c00-a5b8-5081-ba5b-d06a58cf7795" :question/answer-fields "e1fb631e-8d15-57f6-8580-ccaede1aab9a"] [:db/ensure "58813c00-a5b8-5081-ba5b-d06a58cf7795" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186064220 :knowledge-point/questions "58813c00-a5b8-5081-ba5b-d06a58cf7795"] [:db/add "04595e05-af1c-50aa-a0de-42138b20dda7" :answer/id #uuid "04595e05-af1c-50aa-a0de-42138b20dda7"] [:db/add "04595e05-af1c-50aa-a0de-42138b20dda7" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "04595e05-af1c-50aa-a0de-42138b20dda7" :answer/value "2 \pi"] [:db/ensure "04595e05-af1c-50aa-a0de-42138b20dda7" :answer/validate] [:db/add "45409891-4b88-5e6c-8425-841fb8302e5a" :answer-field/id #uuid "45409891-4b88-5e6c-8425-841fb8302e5a"] [:db/add "45409891-4b88-5e6c-8425-841fb8302e5a" :answer-field/key "answer"] [:db/add "45409891-4b88-5e6c-8425-841fb8302e5a" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "45409891-4b88-5e6c-8425-841fb8302e5a" :answer-field/choices "04595e05-af1c-50aa-a0de-42138b20dda7"] [:db/add "45409891-4b88-5e6c-8425-841fb8302e5a" :answer-field/correct "04595e05-af1c-50aa-a0de-42138b20dda7"] [:db/ensure "45409891-4b88-5e6c-8425-841fb8302e5a" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "0f7e23d7-f594-5f67-b9ed-c802d03ed782" :question/id #uuid "0f7e23d7-f594-5f67-b9ed-c802d03ed782"] [:db/add "0f7e23d7-f594-5f67-b9ed-c802d03ed782" :question/problem "Evaluate exactly.

"87288a10-0160-532d-b809-b0f7a4ddc5a5" :question/problem "Evaluate exactly.

$$
\int_{0}^{\frac{1}{8}} \frac{4}{\sqrt{1 - 16 x^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

Choose the exact value."] [:db/add "87288a10-0160-532d-b809-b0f7a4ddc5a5" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=4 x$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(4)\,\mathrm{d}x$.

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{4}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $4\cdot \frac{1}{4}=1$.

Transform both bounds:

$$
\begin{aligned}x=0&\Longrightarrow u=0\\x=\frac{1}{8}&\Longrightarrow u=\frac{1}{2}\end{aligned}
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int_{0}^{\frac{1}{8}} \frac{4}{\sqrt{1 - 16 x^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\int_{0}^{\frac{1}{2}} \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u.\end{aligned}
$$

Endpoint values: $\arcsin{\left(0 \right)}=0,\quad \arcsin{\left(\frac{1}{2} \right)}=\frac{\pi}{6}$.

Use the integration rule:

$$
\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u=\arcsin{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

Evaluate the primitive and subtract lower from upper:

$$
\left[\arcsin{\left(u \right)}\right]_{0}^{\frac{1}{2}}=\left(\frac{\pi}{6}\right)-\left(0\right).
$$

The exact answer is

$$
\frac{\pi}{6}.
$$"] [:db/add "87288a10-0160-532d-b809-b0f7a4ddc5a5" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy] [:db/add "87288a10-0160-532d-b809-b0f7a4ddc5a5" :question/answer-fields $$
\frac{1}{2}\left(\left[\arctan{\left(u \right)}\right]_{0}^{1}\right)=\frac{1}{2}\left(\left(\frac{\pi}{4}\right)-\left(0\right)\right).

"7e848776-98b6-587b-8d7e-6e39a34f98ec" :question/id #uuid "7e848776-98b6-587b-8d7e-6e39a34f98ec"] [:db/add "7e848776-98b6-587b-8d7e-6e39a34f98ec" :question/problem "Evaluate exactly.

$$
\int_{- \frac{1}{5}}^{0} \frac{3}{25 x^{2} + 1}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

Choose the exact value."] [:db/add "7e848776-98b6-587b-8d7e-6e39a34f98ec" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=5 x$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(5)\,\mathrm{d}x$.

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{5}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $3\cdot \frac{1}{5}=\frac{3}{5}$.

Transform both bounds:

$$
\begin{aligned}x=- \frac{1}{5}&\Longrightarrow u=-1\\x=0&\Longrightarrow u=0\end{aligned}
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int_{- \frac{1}{5}}^{0} \frac{3}{25 x^{2} + 1}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{3}{5}\left(\int_{-1}^{0} \frac{1}{u^{2} + 1}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Endpoint values: $\arctan{\left(-1 \right)}=- \frac{\pi}{4},\quad \arctan{\left(0 \right)}=0$.

Use the integration rule:

$$
\int \frac{1}{u^{2} + 1}\,\mathrm{d}u=\arctan{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

Evaluate the primitive and subtract lower from upper:

$$
\frac{3}{5}\left(\left[\arctan{\left(u \right)}\right]_{-1}^{0}\right)=\frac{3}{5}\left(\left(0\right)-\left(- \frac{\pi}{4}\right)\right).
$$

The exact answer is

$$
\frac{3 \pi}{20}.
$$"] [:db/add "7e848776-98b6-587b-8d7e-6e39a34f98ec" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy] [:db/add "7e848776-98b6-587b-8d7e-6e39a34f98ec" :question/answer-fields "837b2f87-f619-55e2-a896-14f85a03de55"] [:db/add "837b2f87-f619-55e2-a896-14f85a03de55" :question/problem "Evaluate exactly.

$$
\int_{0}^{\frac{1}{4}} \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - 4 x^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

Choose the exact value."] [:db/add "837b2f87-f619-55e2-a896-14f85a03de55" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=2 x$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(2)\,\mathrm{d}x$.

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{2}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $1\cdot \frac{1}{2}=\frac{1}{2}$.

Transform both bounds:

$$
\begin{aligned}x=0&\Longrightarrow u=0\\x=\frac{1}{4}&\Longrightarrow u=\frac{1}{2}\end{aligned}
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int_{0}^{\frac{1}{4}} \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - 4 x^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{1}{2}\left(\int_{0}^{\frac{1}{2}} \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Endpoint values: $\arcsin{\left(0 \right)}=0,\quad \arcsin{\left(\frac{1}{2} \right)}=\frac{\pi}{6}$.

Use the integration rule:

$$
\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u=\arcsin{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

Evaluate the primitive and subtract lower from upper:

$$
\frac{1}{2}\left(\left[\arcsin{\left(u \right)}\right]_{0}^{\frac{1}{2}}\right)=\frac{1}{2}\left(\left(\frac{\pi}{6}\right)-\left(0\right)\right).
$$

The exact answer is

$$
\frac{\pi}{12}.
$$"] [:db/add "837b2f87-f619-55e2-a896-14f85a03de55" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy] [:db/add "837b2f87-f619-55e2-a896-14f85a03de55" :question/answer-fields Choose the exact value."] [:db/add "02ac7814-feae-502f-a5b0-0a640bad7add" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=3 x$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(3)\,\mathrm{d}x$.

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{3}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $3\cdot \frac{1}{3}=1$.

Transform both bounds:

$$
\begin{aligned}x=0&\Longrightarrow u=0\\x=\frac{1}{3}&\Longrightarrow u=1\end{aligned}
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int_{0}^{\frac{1}{3}} \frac{3}{9 x^{2} + 1}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\int_{0}^{1} \frac{1}{u^{2} + 1}\,\mathrm{d}u.\end{aligned}
$$

Endpoint values: $\arctan{\left(0 \right)}=0,\quad \arctan{\left(1 \right)}=\frac{\pi}{4}$.

Use the integration rule:

$$
\int \frac{1}{u^{2} + 1}\,\mathrm{d}u=\arctan{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

Evaluate the primitive and subtract lower from upper:

$$
\left[\arctan{\left(u \right)}\right]_{0}^{1}=\left(\frac{\pi}{4}\right)-\left(0\right).
$$

The exact answer is

$$
\frac{\pi}{4}.
$$"] [:db/add "02ac7814-feae-502f-a5b0-0a640bad7add" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy] [:db/add "02ac7814-feae-502f-a5b0-0a640bad7add" :question/answer-fields "45987194-c381-5d45-a67a-878e85bf93e8" :question/id #uuid "45987194-c381-5d45-a67a-878e85bf93e8"] [:db/add "45987194-c381-5d45-a67a-878e85bf93e8" :question/problem "Evaluate exactly.

Choose the exact value."] [:db/add "45987194-c381-5d45-a67a-878e85bf93e8" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=4 x$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(4)\,\mathrm{d}x$.

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{4}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $3\cdot \frac{1}{4}=\frac{3}{4}$.

Transform both bounds:

$$
\begin{aligned}x=- \frac{1}{8}&\Longrightarrow u=- \frac{1}{2}\\x=0&\Longrightarrow u=0\end{aligned}
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int_{- \frac{1}{8}}^{0} \frac{3}{\sqrt{1 - 16 x^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{3}{4}\left(\int_{- \frac{1}{2}}^{0} \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Endpoint values: $\arcsin{\left(- \frac{1}{2} \right)}=- \frac{\pi}{6},\quad \arcsin{\left(0 \right)}=0$.

Use the integration rule:

$$
\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u=\arcsin{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

Evaluate the primitive and subtract lower from upper:

$$
\frac{3}{4}\left(\left[\arcsin{\left(u \right)}\right]_{- \frac{1}{2}}^{0}\right)=\frac{3}{4}\left(\left(0\right)-\left(- \frac{\pi}{6}\right)\right).
$$

The exact answer is

$$
\frac{\pi}{8}.
$$"] [:db/add "45987194-c381-5d45-a67a-878e85bf93e8" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy] [:db/add "45987194-c381-5d45-a67a-878e85bf93e8" :question/answer-fields "10a86c5d-b9dc-5297-ab21-4f6e03f59eca" :question/id #uuid "10a86c5d-b9dc-5297-ab21-4f6e03f59eca"] [:db/add "10a86c5d-b9dc-5297-ab21-4f6e03f59eca" :question/problem "Evaluate exactly.

$$
\int_{- \frac{1}{5}}^{0} \frac{2}{25 x^{2} + 1}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

Choose the exact value."] [:db/add "10a86c5d-b9dc-5297-ab21-4f6e03f59eca" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=5 x$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(5)\,\mathrm{d}x$.

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{5}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $2\cdot \frac{1}{5}=\frac{2}{5}$.

Transform both bounds:

$$
\begin{aligned}x=- \frac{1}{5}&\Longrightarrow u=-1\\x=0&\Longrightarrow u=0\end{aligned}
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int_{- \frac{1}{5}}^{0} \frac{2}{25 x^{2} + 1}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{2}{5}\left(\int_{-1}^{0} \frac{1}{u^{2} + 1}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Endpoint values: $\arctan{\left(-1 \right)}=- \frac{\pi}{4},\quad \arctan{\left(0 \right)}=0$.

Use the integration rule:

$$
\int \frac{1}{u^{2} + 1}\,\mathrm{d}u=\arctan{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

Evaluate the primitive and subtract lower from upper:

$$
\frac{2}{5}\left(\left[\arctan{\left(u \right)}\right]_{-1}^{0}\right)=\frac{2}{5}\left(\left(0\right)-\left(- \frac{\pi}{4}\right)\right).
$$

The exact answer is

$$
\frac{\pi}{10}.
$$"] [:db/add "10a86c5d-b9dc-5297-ab21-4f6e03f59eca" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy] [:db/add "10a86c5d-b9dc-5297-ab21-4f6e03f59eca" :question/answer-fields "c5cb26e3-8759-56b5-bb30-313381ee7280"] [:db/ensure "10a86c5d-b9dc-5297-ab21-4f6e03f59eca" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186064220 :knowledge-point/questions "10a86c5d-b9dc-5297-ab21-4f6e03f59eca"] [:db/add "ce6bc08f-8eed-50f7-8ce0-d6396cded99c" :answer/id #uuid "ce6bc08f-8eed-50f7-8ce0-d6396cded99c"] [:db/add "ce6bc08f-8eed-50f7-8ce0-d6396cded99c" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "ce6bc08f-8eed-50f7-8ce0-d6396cded99c" :answer/value "\frac{\pi}{10}"] [:db/ensure "ce6bc08f-8eed-50f7-8ce0-d6396cded99c" :answer/validate] [:db/add "5e4c11c1-503a-5f4e-9d8b-b90474f087ce" :answer-field/id #uuid "5e4c11c1-503a-5f4e-9d8b-b90474f087ce"] [:db/add "5e4c11c1-503a-5f4e-9d8b-b90474f087ce" :answer-field/key "answer"] [:db/add "5e4c11c1-503a-5f4e-9d8b-b90474f087ce" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "5e4c11c1-503a-5f4e-9d8b-b90474f087ce" :answer-field/choices "ce6bc08f-8eed-50f7-8ce0-d6396cded99c"] [:db/add "5e4c11c1-503a-5f4e-9d8b-b90474f087ce" :answer-field/correct "ce6bc08f-8eed-50f7-8ce0-d6396cded99c"] [:db/ensure "5e4c11c1-503a-5f4e-9d8b-b90474f087ce" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "e99bd3d1-b2c7-55da-9169-4f058c9afd0b" :question/id #uuid "e99bd3d1-b2c7-55da-9169-4f058c9afd0b"] [:db/add "e99bd3d1-b2c7-55da-9169-4f058c9afd0b" :question/problem "Evaluate exactly.

$$
\int_{0}^{5} \frac{2}{x^{2} + 25}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

{{answer}}"] [:db/add "e99bd3d1-b2c7-55da-9169-4f058c9afd0b" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=\frac{x}{5}$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(\frac{1}{5})\,\mathrm{d}x$.

Normalize the denominator:

$$
x^{2} + 25=25\left(1+(\frac{x}{5})^2\right).
$$

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=5\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $\frac{2}{25}\cdot 5=\frac{2}{5}$.

Transform both bounds:

$$
\begin{aligned}x=0&\Longrightarrow u=0\\x=5&\Longrightarrow u=1\end{aligned}
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int_{0}^{5} \frac{2}{x^{2} + 25}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{2}{5}\left(\int_{0}^{1} \frac{1}{u^{2} + 1}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Endpoint values: $\arctan{\left(0 \right)}=0,\quad \arctan{\left(1 \right)}=\frac{\pi}{4}$.

Use the integration rule:

$$
\int \frac{1}{u^{2} + 1}\,\mathrm{d}u=\arctan{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

Evaluate the primitive and subtract lower from upper:

$$
\frac{2}{5}\left(\left[\arctan{\left(u \right)}\right]_{0}^{1}\right)=\frac{2}{5}\left(\left(\frac{\pi}{4}\right)-\left(0\right)\right).
$$

The exact answer is

$$
\frac{\pi}{10}.
$$"] [:db/add "e99bd3d1-b2c7-55da-9169-4f058c9afd0b" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate] [:db/add "e99bd3d1-b2c7-55da-9169-4f058c9afd0b" :question/answer-fields "5e4c11c1-503a-5f4e-9d8b-b90474f087ce"] [:db/ensure "e99bd3d1-b2c7-55da-9169-4f058c9afd0b" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186064220 :knowledge-point/questions "e99bd3d1-b2c7-55da-9169-4f058c9afd0b"] [:db/add "b4efd285-7561-56f4-bccc-435c7e27f225" :answer/id #uuid "b4efd285-7561-56f4-bccc-435c7e27f225"] [:db/add "b4efd285-7561-56f4-bccc-435c7e27f225" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "b4efd285-7561-56f4-bccc-435c7e27f225" :answer/value "\frac{\pi}{3}"] [:db/ensure "b4efd285-7561-56f4-bccc-435c7e27f225" :answer/validate] [:db/add "c2c51ac5-8776-5b03-b151-314d5edb2a90" :answer-field/id #uuid "c2c51ac5-8776-5b03-b151-314d5edb2a90"] [:db/add "c2c51ac5-8776-5b03-b151-314d5edb2a90" :answer-field/key "answer"] [:db/add "c2c51ac5-8776-5b03-b151-314d5edb2a90" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "c2c51ac5-8776-5b03-b151-314d5edb2a90" :answer-field/choices "b4efd285-7561-56f4-bccc-435c7e27f225"] [:db/add "c2c51ac5-8776-5b03-b151-314d5edb2a90" :answer-field/correct "b4efd285-7561-56f4-bccc-435c7e27f225"] [:db/ensure "c2c51ac5-8776-5b03-b151-314d5edb2a90" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "46f7c08c-b23a-52df-8bc9-26e935781bdc" :question/id #uuid "46f7c08c-b23a-52df-8bc9-26e935781bdc"] [:db/add "46f7c08c-b23a-52df-8bc9-26e935781bdc" :question/problem "Evaluate exactly.

$$
\int_{0}^{2} \frac{2}{\sqrt{16 - x^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

{{answer}}"] [:db/add "46f7c08c-b23a-52df-8bc9-26e935781bdc" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=\frac{x}{4}$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(\frac{1}{4})\,\mathrm{d}x$.

Normalize the denominator:

$$
\sqrt{16 - x^{2}}=4\sqrt{1-(\frac{x}{4})^2}.
$$

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=4\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $\frac{1}{2}\cdot 4=2$.

Transform both bounds:

$$
\begin{aligned}x=0&\Longrightarrow u=0\\x=2&\Longrightarrow u=\frac{1}{2}\end{aligned}
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int_{0}^{2} \frac{2}{\sqrt{16 - x^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=2\left(\int_{0}^{\frac{1}{2}} \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Endpoint values: $\arcsin{\left(0 \right)}=0,\quad \arcsin{\left(\frac{1}{2} \right)}=\frac{\pi}{6}$.

Use the integration rule:

$$
\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u=\arcsin{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

Evaluate the primitive and subtract lower from upper:

$$
2\left(\left[\arcsin{\left(u \right)}\right]_{0}^{\frac{1}{2}}\right)=2\left(\left(\frac{\pi}{6}\right)-\left(0\right)\right).
$$

The exact answer is

$$
\frac{\pi}{3}.
$$"] [:db/add "46f7c08c-b23a-52df-8bc9-26e935781bdc" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate] [:db/add "46f7c08c-b23a-52df-8bc9-26e935781bdc" :question/answer-fields "c2c51ac5-8776-5b03-b151-314d5edb2a90"] [:db/ensure "46f7c08c-b23a-52df-8bc9-26e935781bdc" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186064220 :knowledge-point/questions "46f7c08c-b23a-52df-8bc9-26e935781bdc"] [:db/add "cd2d16ed-0a22-517d-aff0-2fc17e5cbd6c" :answer/id #uuid "cd2d16ed-0a22-517d-aff0-2fc17e5cbd6c"] [:db/add "cd2d16ed-0a22-517d-aff0-2fc17e5cbd6c" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "cd2d16ed-0a22-517d-aff0-2fc17e5cbd6c" :answer/value "\frac{\pi}{15}"] [:db/ensure "cd2d16ed-0a22-517d-aff0-2fc17e5cbd6c" :answer/validate] [:db/add "1749ef1b-b7dd-5332-b751-7e02c047f761" :answer-field/id #uuid "1749ef1b-b7dd-5332-b751-7e02c047f761"] [:db/add "1749ef1b-b7dd-5332-b751-7e02c047f761" :answer-field/key "answer"] [:db/add "1749ef1b-b7dd-5332-b751-7e02c047f761" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "1749ef1b-b7dd-5332-b751-7e02c047f761" :answer-field/choices "cd2d16ed-0a22-517d-aff0-2fc17e5cbd6c"] [:db/add "1749ef1b-b7dd-5332-b751-7e02c047f761" :answer-field/correct "cd2d16ed-0a22-517d-aff0-2fc17e5cbd6c"] [:db/ensure "1749ef1b-b7dd-5332-b751-7e02c047f761" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "29922848-0161-5ee9-b650-fe402a88aa8f" :question/id #uuid "29922848-0161-5ee9-b650-fe402a88aa8f"] [:db/add "29922848-0161-5ee9-b650-fe402a88aa8f" :question/problem "Evaluate exactly.

\begin{aligned}&\int_{0}^{\frac{5 \sqrt{2}}{2}} \frac{4}{\sqrt{25 - x^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=4\left(\int_{0}^{\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}} \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Endpoint values: $\arcsin{\left(0 \right)}=0,\quad \arcsin{\left(\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2} \right)}=\frac{\pi}{4}$.

$$
\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u=\arcsin{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

Evaluate the primitive and subtract lower from upper:

$$
4\left(\left[\arcsin{\left(u \right)}\right]_{0}^{\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}}\right)=4\left(\left(\frac{\pi}{4}\right)-\left(0\right)\right).
$$

The exact answer is

$$
\pi.

$$

{{answer}}"] [:db/add "b5286232-dcfd-5ef5-b3e2-5f7420d2ca2f" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=\frac{x}{4}$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(\frac{1}{4})\,\mathrm{d}x$.

Normalize the denominator:

$$
x^{2} + 16=16\left(1+(\frac{x}{4})^2\right).
$$

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=4\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $\frac{1}{8}\cdot 4=\frac{1}{2}$.

Transform both bounds:

$$
\begin{aligned}x=-4&\Longrightarrow u=-1\\x=4&\Longrightarrow u=1\end{aligned}
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int_{-4}^{4} \frac{2}{x^{2} + 16}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{1}{2}\left(\int_{-1}^{1} \frac{1}{u^{2} + 1}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Endpoint values: $\arctan{\left(-1 \right)}=- \frac{\pi}{4},\quad \arctan{\left(1 \right)}=\frac{\pi}{4}$.

Use the integration rule:

$$
\int \frac{1}{u^{2} + 1}\,\mathrm{d}u=\arctan{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

Evaluate the primitive and subtract lower from upper:

$$
\frac{1}{2}\left(\left[\arctan{\left(u \right)}\right]_{-1}^{1}\right)=\frac{1}{2}\left(\left(\frac{\pi}{4}\right)-\left(- \frac{\pi}{4}\right)\right).
$$

The exact answer is

$$
\frac{\pi}{4}.
$$"] [:db/add "b5286232-dcfd-5ef5-b3e2-5f7420d2ca2f" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate] [:db/add "b5286232-dcfd-5ef5-b3e2-5f7420d2ca2f" :question/answer-fields "e4e0a536-3443-5d5d-926c-ef349b9c9b62"] [:db/ensure "b5286232-dcfd-5ef5-b3e2-5f7420d2ca2f" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186064220 :knowledge-point/questions "b5286232-dcfd-5ef5-b3e2-5f7420d2ca2f"] [:db/add "b6d82fcd-f8e6-5c42-9362-e0c21d7f479f" :answer/id #uuid "b6d82fcd-f8e6-5c42-9362-e0c21d7f479f"] [:db/add "b6d82fcd-f8e6-5c42-9362-e0c21d7f479f" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "b6d82fcd-f8e6-5c42-9362-e0c21d7f479f" :answer/value "\frac{\pi}{3}"] [:db/ensure "b6d82fcd-f8e6-5c42-9362-e0c21d7f479f" :answer/validate] [:db/add "5071aab3-0b63-575b-8580-6b3743d0842b" :answer-field/id #uuid "5071aab3-0b63-575b-8580-6b3743d0842b"] [:db/add "5071aab3-0b63-575b-8580-6b3743d0842b" :answer-field/key "answer"] [:db/add "5071aab3-0b63-575b-8580-6b3743d0842b" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "5071aab3-0b63-575b-8580-6b3743d0842b" :answer-field/choices "b6d82fcd-f8e6-5c42-9362-e0c21d7f479f"] [:db/add "5071aab3-0b63-575b-8580-6b3743d0842b" :answer-field/correct "b6d82fcd-f8e6-5c42-9362-e0c21d7f479f"] [:db/ensure "5071aab3-0b63-575b-8580-6b3743d0842b" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "0ee19251-9ec3-50f8-afac-37a3b36232b0" :question/id #uuid "0ee19251-9ec3-50f8-afac-37a3b36232b0"] [:db/add "0ee19251-9ec3-50f8-afac-37a3b36232b0" :question/problem "Evaluate exactly.

{{answer}}"] [:db/add "0ee19251-9ec3-50f8-afac-37a3b36232b0" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=\frac{x}{3}$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(\frac{1}{3})\,\mathrm{d}x$.

$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int_{- \frac{3}{2}}^{\frac{3}{2}} \frac{1}{\sqrt{9 - x^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\int_{- \frac{1}{2}}^{\frac{1}{2}} \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u.\end{aligned}

$$
\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u=\arcsin{\left(u \right)}+C.

Evaluate the primitive and subtract lower from upper:

$$
\left[\arcsin{\left(u \right)}\right]_{- \frac{1}{2}}^{\frac{1}{2}}=\left(\frac{\pi}{6}\right)-\left(- \frac{\pi}{6}\right).
$$

The exact answer is

$$
\frac{\pi}{3}.
$$"] [:db/add "0ee19251-9ec3-50f8-afac-37a3b36232b0" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate] [:db/add "0ee19251-9ec3-50f8-afac-37a3b36232b0" :question/answer-fields "5071aab3-0b63-575b-8580-6b3743d0842b"] [:db/ensure "0ee19251-9ec3-50f8-afac-37a3b36232b0" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186064220 :knowledge-point/questions "0ee19251-9ec3-50f8-afac-37a3b36232b0"] [:db/add "57a22543-28d5-5089-8691-a57799840d66" :answer/id #uuid "57a22543-28d5-5089-8691-a57799840d66"] [:db/add "57a22543-28d5-5089-8691-a57799840d66" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "57a22543-28d5-5089-8691-a57799840d66" :answer/value "\frac{\pi}{18}"] [:db/ensure "57a22543-28d5-5089-8691-a57799840d66" :answer/validate] [:db/add "1f2fd66c-c278-5547-a2e0-a6c78f6e834b" :answer-field/id #uuid "1f2fd66c-c278-5547-a2e0-a6c78f6e834b"] [:db/add "1f2fd66c-c278-5547-a2e0-a6c78f6e834b" :answer-field/key "answer"] [:db/add "1f2fd66c-c278-5547-a2e0-a6c78f6e834b" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "1f2fd66c-c278-5547-a2e0-a6c78f6e834b" :answer-field/choices "57a22543-28d5-5089-8691-a57799840d66"] [:db/add "1f2fd66c-c278-5547-a2e0-a6c78f6e834b" :answer-field/correct "57a22543-28d5-5089-8691-a57799840d66"] [:db/ensure "1f2fd66c-c278-5547-a2e0-a6c78f6e834b" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "ba24a3c5-0af8-5f12-bad0-104365814844" :question/id #uuid "ba24a3c5-0af8-5f12-bad0-104365814844"] [:db/add "ba24a3c5-0af8-5f12-bad0-104365814844" :question/problem "Evaluate exactly.

{{answer}}"] [:db/add "ba24a3c5-0af8-5f12-bad0-104365814844" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=\frac{x}{3}$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(\frac{1}{3})\,\mathrm{d}x$.

{{answer}}"] [:db/add "fc989089-ee91-5602-b354-1363e3229631" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=\frac{\sqrt{2} x}{2}$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2})\,\mathrm{d}x$.

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int_{-1}^{0} \frac{2}{\sqrt{2 - x^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=2\left(\int_{- \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}}^{0} \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}

$$

{{answer}}"] [:db/add "58813c00-a5b8-5081-ba5b-d06a58cf7795" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=\frac{\sqrt{3} x}{6}$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{6})\,\mathrm{d}x$.

$$
x^{2} + 12=12\left(1+(\frac{\sqrt{3} x}{6})^2\right).

Transform both bounds:

$$
\begin{aligned}x=-6&\Longrightarrow u=- \sqrt{3}\\x=0&\Longrightarrow u=0\end{aligned}
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int_{-6}^{0} \frac{1}{x^{2} + 12}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{\sqrt{3}}{6}\left(\int_{- \sqrt{3}}^{0} \frac{1}{u^{2} + 1}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Endpoint values: $\arctan{\left(- \sqrt{3} \right)}=- \frac{\pi}{3},\quad \arctan{\left(0 \right)}=0$.

Use the integration rule:

$$
\int \frac{1}{u^{2} + 1}\,\mathrm{d}u=\arctan{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

Evaluate the primitive and subtract lower from upper:

$$
\frac{\sqrt{3}}{6}\left(\left[\arctan{\left(u \right)}\right]_{- \sqrt{3}}^{0}\right)=\frac{\sqrt{3}}{6}\left(\left(0\right)-\left(- \frac{\pi}{3}\right)\right).
$$

The exact answer is

$$
\frac{\sqrt{3} \pi}{18}.
$$"] [:db/add "58813c00-a5b8-5081-ba5b-d06a58cf7795" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/hard] [:db/add "58813c00-a5b8-5081-ba5b-d06a58cf7795" :question/answer-fields "e1fb631e-8d15-57f6-8580-ccaede1aab9a"] [:db/ensure "58813c00-a5b8-5081-ba5b-d06a58cf7795" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186064220 :knowledge-point/questions "58813c00-a5b8-5081-ba5b-d06a58cf7795"] [:db/add "04595e05-af1c-50aa-a0de-42138b20dda7" :answer/id #uuid "04595e05-af1c-50aa-a0de-42138b20dda7"] [:db/add "04595e05-af1c-50aa-a0de-42138b20dda7" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "04595e05-af1c-50aa-a0de-42138b20dda7" :answer/value "2 \pi"] [:db/ensure "04595e05-af1c-50aa-a0de-42138b20dda7" :answer/validate] [:db/add "45409891-4b88-5e6c-8425-841fb8302e5a" :answer-field/id #uuid "45409891-4b88-5e6c-8425-841fb8302e5a"] [:db/add "45409891-4b88-5e6c-8425-841fb8302e5a" :answer-field/key "answer"] [:db/add "45409891-4b88-5e6c-8425-841fb8302e5a" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "45409891-4b88-5e6c-8425-841fb8302e5a" :answer-field/choices "04595e05-af1c-50aa-a0de-42138b20dda7"] [:db/add "45409891-4b88-5e6c-8425-841fb8302e5a" :answer-field/correct "04595e05-af1c-50aa-a0de-42138b20dda7"] [:db/ensure "45409891-4b88-5e6c-8425-841fb8302e5a" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "0f7e23d7-f594-5f67-b9ed-c802d03ed782" :question/id #uuid "0f7e23d7-f594-5f67-b9ed-c802d03ed782"] [:db/add "0f7e23d7-f594-5f67-b9ed-c802d03ed782" :question/problem "Evaluate exactly.

Choose the exact value."] ["87288a10-0160-532d-b809-b0f7a4ddc5a5" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=4 x$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(4)\,\mathrm{d}x$.

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{4}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $4\cdot \frac{1}{4}=1$.

Transform both bounds:

$$
\begin{aligned}x=0&\Longrightarrow u=0\\x=\frac{1}{8}&\Longrightarrow u=\frac{1}{2}\end{aligned}
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int_{0}^{\frac{1}{8}} \frac{4}{\sqrt{1 - 16 x^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\int_{0}^{\frac{1}{2}} \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u.\end{aligned}
$$

Endpoint values: $\arcsin{\left(0 \right)}=0,\quad \arcsin{\left(\frac{1}{2} \right)}=\frac{\pi}{6}$.

Use the integration rule:

$$
\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u=\arcsin{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

Evaluate the primitive and subtract lower from upper:

$$
\left[\arcsin{\left(u \right)}\right]_{0}^{\frac{1}{2}}=\left(\frac{\pi}{6}\right)-\left(0\right).
$$

The exact answer is

$$
\frac{\pi}{6}.
$$"] ["87288a10-0160-532d-b809-b0f7a4ddc5a5" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy] ["87288a10-0160-532d-b809-b0f7a4ddc5a5" :question/answer-fields "5a2854ef-33d9-598b-9aef-0ec815f45e65"] The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{5}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $2\cdot \frac{1}{5}=\frac{2}{5}$.

Transform both bounds:

$$
\begin{aligned}x=- \frac{1}{5}&\Longrightarrow u=-1\\x=0&\Longrightarrow u=0\end{aligned}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int_{- \frac{1}{5}}^{0} \frac{2}{25 x^{2} + 1}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{2}{5}\left(\int_{-1}^{0} \frac{1}{u^{2} + 1}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Endpoint values: $\arctan{\left(-1 \right)}=- \frac{\pi}{4},\quad \arctan{\left(0 \right)}=0$.

Use the integration rule:

$$
\int \frac{1}{u^{2} + 1}\,\mathrm{d}u=\arctan{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

Evaluate the primitive and subtract lower from upper:

$$
\frac{2}{5}\left(\left[\arctan{\left(u \right)}\right]_{-1}^{0}\right)=\frac{2}{5}\left(\left(0\right)-\left(- \frac{\pi}{4}\right)\right).
$$

The exact answer is

{{answer}}"] ["e99bd3d1-b2c7-55da-9169-4f058c9afd0b" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=\frac{x}{5}$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(\frac{1}{5})\,\mathrm{d}x$.

$$

Transform both bounds:

$$
\begin{aligned}x=0&\Longrightarrow u=0\\x=5&\Longrightarrow u=1\end{aligned}

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int_{0}^{5} \frac{2}{x^{2} + 25}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{2}{5}\left(\int_{0}^{1} \frac{1}{u^{2} + 1}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Endpoint values: $\arctan{\left(0 \right)}=0,\quad \arctan{\left(1 \right)}=\frac{\pi}{4}$.

Use the integration rule:

$$
\int \frac{1}{u^{2} + 1}\,\mathrm{d}u=\arctan{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

Evaluate the primitive and subtract lower from upper:

$$
\frac{2}{5}\left(\left[\arctan{\left(u \right)}\right]_{0}^{1}\right)=\frac{2}{5}\left(\left(\frac{\pi}{4}\right)-\left(0\right)\right).
$$

The exact answer is

$$
\frac{\pi}{10}.

{{answer}}"] ["46f7c08c-b23a-52df-8bc9-26e935781bdc" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=\frac{x}{4}$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(\frac{1}{4})\,\mathrm{d}x$.

{{answer}}"] ["ba24a3c5-0af8-5f12-bad0-104365814844" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=\frac{x}{3}$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(\frac{1}{3})\,\mathrm{d}x$.

Normalize the denominator:

$$
x^{2} + 9=9\left(1+(\frac{x}{3})^2\right).
$$

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=3\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $\frac{2}{9}\cdot 3=\frac{2}{3}$.

Transform both bounds:

$$
\begin{aligned}x=\sqrt{3}&\Longrightarrow u=\frac{\sqrt{3}}{3}\\x=3&\Longrightarrow u=1\end{aligned}
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int_{\sqrt{3}}^{3} \frac{2}{x^{2} + 9}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{2}{3}\left(\int_{\frac{\sqrt{3}}{3}}^{1} \frac{1}{u^{2} + 1}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Endpoint values: $\arctan{\left(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{3} \right)}=\frac{\pi}{6},\quad \arctan{\left(1 \right)}=\frac{\pi}{4}$.

Use the integration rule:

$$
\int \frac{1}{u^{2} + 1}\,\mathrm{d}u=\arctan{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

Evaluate the primitive and subtract lower from upper:

$$
\frac{2}{3}\left(\left[\arctan{\left(u \right)}\right]_{\frac{\sqrt{3}}{3}}^{1}\right)=\frac{2}{3}\left(\left(\frac{\pi}{4}\right)-\left(\frac{\pi}{6}\right)\right).
$$

The exact answer is

{{answer}}"] ["1371c8ad-ea4c-52bc-a8be-cbd7cd21bedd" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=\frac{\sqrt{2} x}{4}$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(\frac{\sqrt{2}}{4})\,\mathrm{d}x$.

$$

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=2 \sqrt{2}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $\sqrt{2}\cdot 2 \sqrt{2}=4$.

Transform both bounds:

$$
\begin{aligned}x=\sqrt{2}&\Longrightarrow u=\frac{1}{2}\\x=2&\Longrightarrow u=\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\end{aligned}
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int_{\sqrt{2}}^{2} \frac{4}{\sqrt{8 - x^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=4\left(\int_{\frac{1}{2}}^{\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}} \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Endpoint values: $\arcsin{\left(\frac{1}{2} \right)}=\frac{\pi}{6},\quad \arcsin{\left(\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2} \right)}=\frac{\pi}{4}$.

Use the integration rule:

$$
\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u=\arcsin{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

Evaluate the primitive and subtract lower from upper:

$$
4\left(\left[\arcsin{\left(u \right)}\right]_{\frac{1}{2}}^{\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}}\right)=4\left(\left(\frac{\pi}{4}\right)-\left(\frac{\pi}{6}\right)\right).
$$

The exact answer is

$$
\frac{\pi}{3}.
